title: Grateful Dead Live at Thelma Theater on 1969-12-11
lineage: MAC >> Nakamichi DR-1 => Grace Design Lunatec V3 [Pre-Only] => Korg MR-1000 >> DSF [1-bit 5.6448 MHz Stereo] >> Korg MR-1000 => Korg AudioGate >> WAV [24/96]
source: 1 x Sony Microphone => Sony Portable Cassette Recorder [Monophonic] >> MAC

ai_review.summary: Excellent one‑mic audience recording that captures a laid‑back yet intriguing Dark Star (with an Airplane snippet) and solid overall performance.
ai_review.review: The MOTB audience tape is praised for its crystal‑clear, single‑mic capture, making the band’s relaxed vibe come through vividly. Reviewers highlight a noteworthy Dark Star segue featuring an Airplane excerpt, noting it isn’t as fully developed as the famed 11‑02 version but remains interesting. Overall the show feels comfortably loose with good energy and no major flaws.

ai_rating.rationale: Recording quality is described as excellent; musical performance is solid with a standout Dark Star, yielding a strong combined rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: One‑mic audience tape praised for being clean, crisp and surprisingly detailed despite its simplicity; no reported dropouts or balance issues.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Relaxed set with a laid‑back vibe; Dark Star receives special attention but overall the show flows smoothly without major hiccups.

band_member_comments.Keys: TC (Tom Constanten) noted as a great addition, adding to the keyboard texture.
